add_executable(dualforge_attitude_web main.cpp)
set_target_properties(dualforge_attitude_web PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(dualforge_attitude_web PRIVATE DualForge::DualForge ws2_32 shell32)
target_compile_definitions(dualforge_attitude_web PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(dualforge_attitude_web PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(dualforge_attitude_web PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
add_custom_command(TARGET dualforge_attitude_web POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_FILE:SDL3::SDL3> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dualforge_attitude_web>
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/web" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dualforge_attitude_web>/attitude_web")
if(MINGW)
    get_filename_component(_attitude_compiler_dir "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" DIRECTORY)
    foreach(_dll libstdc++-6.dll libgcc_s_seh-1.dll libwinpthread-1.dll)
        if(EXISTS "${_attitude_compiler_dir}/${_dll}")
            add_custom_command(TARGET dualforge_attitude_web POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${_attitude_compiler_dir}/${_dll}" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dualforge_attitude_web>)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
if(DUALFORGE_BUILD_TESTS)
    add_executable(test_attitude test_attitude.cpp)
    target_compile_features(test_attitude PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
    add_test(NAME attitude COMMAND test_attitude)
endif()
